name: Margaret Higgins
psychographics: Values autonomy and order; enjoys the ritual of cooking but resents the administrative burden of meal planning
current_solutions: Uses a subscription-based Blue Apron service for recipe inspiration, paired with a Samsung Family Hub refrigerator to track groceries and set timers. She also uses the Any.do calendar app to coordinate dinner nights with her bridge club.
frustration: At 6:15 PM on a Tuesday last week, the smart oven preheated itself to the wrong temperature (375°F instead of 400°F) for her roast chicken, forcing her to cancel a dinner party she had spent all day prepping for; the voice command misheard 'four hundred' as 'three seventy-five'.
decision_style: She research products on Consumer Reports for months before buying, but once she trusts a brand, she sticks with it religiously and rarely compares prices.
voice: Calm, measured, and precise. She speaks in complete sentences, often qualifying her statements with 'actually' or 'as I was saying,' and refers to technology by its brand name rather than generic terms.
